title: Constraints on Dynamical Dark Energy from Multiple Probes in the Full Dark Energy Survey (DES Collaboration)
efc_relevance: Full DES Y6 multi-probe combination (SNe + BAO + 3×2pt) yields w_0 = −0.84 ± 0.10, w_a = −0.44 ± 0.6 with a 2.3σ deviation from ΛCDM when combined with DESI DR2 BAO. Direct successor to arXiv:2602.10065 (DES Y6 cosmic shear) and arXiv:2601.14559 (DES Y6 3×2pt) — provides the multi-probe DE-evolution anchor EFC's L2→L3 effective w(z) must reproduce.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as primary multi-probe DE-evolution constraint; supersede preliminary DES-Y6 DE rows; cross-reference arXiv:2503.14738 (DESI DR2 BAO) and arXiv:2602.10065; update P-series predictions to publish EFC's (w_0, w_a) point estimate against the DES+DESI 2.3σ ellipse; required head-to-head ΔAIC vs framework:LCDM-Planck2018, framework:wCDM-CPL-Chevallier2001, and framework:Quintom-Feng2005.
